abstract: Maintains structural stability ratings, seismic isolation certifications, and engineering upkeep records
system_message:
You are the Structural and seismic engineering lead (STR), responsible for tracking structural stability ratings, seismic isolation certifications, and facility upkeep expenditures across archival depositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface bedrock testing（BEDRK）
information_points.content:
STR-BEDRK-DKU：Geotechnical core borehole survey results for the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository show an unconfined bedrock compressive strength of 75 MPa in the subterranean bedrock stratum.
STR-BEDRK-HAK：Geotechnical core borehole survey results for the Chianti Geological Archive Vault show an unconfined bedrock compressive strength of 60 MPa in the subterranean bedrock stratum.
STR-BEDRK-2GL：Geotechnical core borehole survey results for the Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum show an unconfined bedrock compressive strength of 45 MPa in the subterranean bedrock stratum.

information_points.title: Maintains structural stability ratings, seismic isolation certifications, and engineering upkeep records（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STR-SEIS-RFJ：For the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository, the subterranean vault structural envelope holds seismically isolated structural certification under Eurocode 8, and its annual facility maintenance cost is 160000 EUR on the basis of gross expenditure before deducting municipal preservation subsidies.
STR-SEIS-8ET：For the Chianti Geological Archive Vault, the subterranean vault structural envelope does not hold seismically isolated structural certification under Eurocode 8, and its annual facility maintenance cost is 120000 EUR on the basis of gross expenditure before deducting municipal preservation subsidies.
STR-SEIS-29Q：Under the accounting basis of net expenditure after deducting municipal preservation subsidies, the Monte Morello Subterranean Depository does not have seismically isolated structural certification under Eurocode 8, and its annual facility maintenance cost is recorded as 150000 EUR.
STR-SEIS-P30：For the Valdarno Heritage Conservation Sanctum, the subterranean vault structural envelope holds seismically isolated structural certification under Eurocode 8, and its annual facility maintenance cost is 160000 EUR on the basis of gross expenditure before deducting municipal preservation subsidies.
